in_marathi.name: Rati
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A goddess of love and desire, personification of love and wife of Lord Kamadeva. She is the embodiment of the romantic longing and sexual desire that every human being feels.

in_bengali.name: Rati
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rati একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A goddess of love and desire, personification of love and wife of Lord Kamadeva. She is the embodiment of the romantic longing and sexual desire that every human being feels.
